capabilities: Show nested page tree in sidebar
Create child pages by converting notes to folders
Reorder notes and folders by dragging
Batch move or delete selected notes
extras: Not standalone; requires Folder Notes and Manual Sorting. Folder Notes must be configured to Inside-Folder.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer does not provide a Wolai/Notion-style nested page tree with manual ordering and batch operations.

relations.evidence: Provides the Inside-Folder structure so a folder can have its own body note
A Wolai/Notion-style nested page tree plugin for Obsidian
A Wolai/Notion-style nested page tree plugin for Obsidian

summary: Nested page tree plugin that adds Wolai/Notion-style child pages, drag sorting, batch operations, and undo while syncing with the file system.
